metadata.description:
A resubmit of my first mgs longplay that should be glitch free and higher quality. Played on hard mode with the good ending with minimal alerts, no rations and not going overboard on the killing.

I've edited the video so the tapes come first, followed by the intro movie from before the title screen, before going straight into the main story.
